title: Registradores nota fails when its output directory does not exist
notes: (2026-11-10).** Confirmed run for B22903801 created the order (3,58 EUR,
checkout URL printed), then the notes said
`ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '<dir>/registradores-nota-B22903801-2026-11-10-pago.html'`.
The order is fine; only the payment page file is lost. Smallest next step:
create the `--out` directory recursively before writing.
result: The filing artifact writer creates missing output directories before writing the checkout page.
evidence: pnpm exec vitest run src/registradores/nota src/rolece/filing: the synthetic confirmed order writes its checkout page under a previously missing nested directory without requesting the payment URL.
